messages:
Asha (runtime): Postmortem follow-up: we need a compact action tracker for the KV-cache leak + OOMs. Goals: short-term guards, mid-term profiling, long-term GC/allocator changes.
Miguel: Agreed. Recommend two buckets: 'safety' (eviction, caps, alerts) and 'investigate' (pprof, slab metrics, reproducer).
Priya: Safety items I can pick up: implement configurable per-shard soft eviction and an emergency hard cap with a bounded reject path. ETA: Fri EOD.
Miguel: I'll add unit tests + a small harness that simulates high sequence-length tails to reproduce residency carryover. ETA Wed afternoon.
Jin: Investigation: I'll run three profiling passes (cold, warm, sustained 15m) with allocator flags and slab-sampling, and capture heap + alloc_space pprofs. Will attach to INF-912.
Asha (runtime): Jin, include these commands in the ticket:
```
GODEBUG=allocfreetrace=1 ./runtime --serve
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pprof
```
Sam (oncall): I'll run the canary and monitor the KV-residency slope alert for 48h after deploy. Pager-bot: please lower the alert threshold to catch early drift.
pager-bot: Alert threshold adjusted and note added to INF-912.
Miguel: Also adding a CI assertion: after 5m of synthetic load per-shard growth must be <=10%. If it fails, post a failing artifact.
Priya: Rollback criteria: revert if canary sees >5% client errors or memory drift >25% sustained for 30m.
Asha (runtime): Check-in Thursday 9am PT to verify soft fixes merged and canary window scheduled. I'll update the postmortem with owners and mark statuses. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
